R1 runs from the top rail down to node M, and R2 runs from the top to node N, so R2's bottom end, N, and R3's top end sit on the same net. I'm switching the two transistors to PNP with their emitters on the nets they sit on and their base and collector tied to ground. For M2 that means the emitter goes to net2, and I'm dropping the body pin since PNP doesn't use one.
